description: The meet of two classes modulo finite sets is zero exactly when the intersection of their representatives is finite.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finite_quotient_zero_meet_iff (A B : Set ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ) A ⊓
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ) B =
      ⊥ ↔
    (A ∩ B).Finite
